Multiple Indian States Announce Entrance Exam Counselling Schedules

Several Indian states have released counselling schedules for postgraduate and polytechnic entrance examinations. These announcements, including registration deadlines and allotment dates, are crucial for students seeking admission to various courses. The schedules pertain to examinations like TS PGECET, TGCHE, AP POLYCET, and JEECUP across different states.
